added.summary: Fonts ship as packs, one per script (latin, cyrillic-greek, arabic, hebrew, devanagari, thai, japanese, korean, chinese-simplified, chinese-traditional), each an extension.json of kind font with its faces and licence. `og font list` names them and `og font add <pack>` installs one under assets/fonts/<pack>/.
--lang installs the font pack of each language's script (Chinese by script), with no generated code.

og.i18n chains installed font packs with no code: the locale's own pack, then a pack loaded the first frame its characters are drawn. Pack faces draw from outlines at run time and the web fetches them on demand.

fixed.summary: The locale-fonts warning accepts an installed font pack and covers Devanagari, Thai, Cyrillic and Greek languages too.
A run-time font's glyphs render off the frame (natively on a thread, on the web a few a frame), so a new script's first frame no longer hitches (203 ms on Metal before); captures wait for them.
